documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. Management presented agenda items regarding the adoption of financial statements and the re-appointment of directors including Mr. Frederick Ivor Bendle, Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah, and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's digital ecosystem for dSpeedUp grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits.

capital_allocation.claim: The company stated that no dividend was declared for the year 2015-16.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company has not declared any dividend for the year 2015-16, the transfer of the amount of dividend that remains unclaimed for a period of 7 years to the IEPF account and the shares on which dividends remain unpaid or unclaimed for a period of seven consecutive years or more to the Demat account of IEPF Authority does not arise;

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah was re-appointed as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan was re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that Calsofts remains dedicated to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
